clips.title: A Kaspa bear called 1 cent. Three days later...
clips.hook: The best part about the crypto space is how your entire thesis can break apart before lunch.
clips.caption: This Kaspa bear said the 20-month downtrend never broke and 1 cent $KAS was in play within 4 to 6 months. Calling it like it is, he said. Three days later, we blew him out of the water, man.

clips.title: Golden Kitty at $5.3M, and I already called the next stop
clips.hook: Golden Kitty at 5.3 million. This thing is like rocking, man.
clips.caption: Golden Kitty ($GOLDEN) at a $5.3M market cap and this thing is rocking. A few days before this I called 8 million, and with so many people getting behind it, realistically it could get there fast. 🚀

clips.title: The first vProg on Kaspa is a game of tic-tac-toe. Here's why that's so bullish
clips.hook: So the first vProg is live. Tic-tac-toe on Kaspa testnet.
clips.caption: The first vProg is live on Kaspa testnet: tic-tac-toe, a verifiable program with real execution and real settlement. Verifiable programs on the L1 means anybody can build anything they want, and it runs on a proof of work coin. Really, really bullish for $KAS long term, and the KRC20s are gonna get hot too.

clips.title: We just did a 114x in eight days
clips.hook: We just got a nice runner. The biggest one was 114x.
clips.caption: Biggest runner in our community over three weeks: $PERPSPAD on Solana, 90K on the 5th to over 10 million on the 13th. That's a 114x in eight days. Plus 17x on $ETHICS and 13x on $STONK. Over 100 plays in the community, and this run-up is gonna be so fun. 🔥
